data.gender_notes: Hemamalini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hemamalini is a beautiful Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'hema' meaning gold and 'malini' meaning lotus. It is a name that signifies beauty, grace, and purity. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a sacred symbol representing creation, detachment, and enlightenment. The name Hemamalini carries the meaning “Golden Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemamalini usually hope their child will grow to embody golden lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May you bloom like a lotus in the pond of life, radiant and pure.
data.etymology: Hemamalini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemamalini total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.spiritual_significance: The Name Hemamalini carries deep spiritual significance as it represents the union of the divine qualities of gold (hema) and the lotus (malini). Thus, the name Hemamalini signifies an individual who embodies these divine qualities and is on the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
